import { Component, inject } from '@angular/core'; import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common'; import { ExportImportDataService, Shipment } from '../../services/export-import-data.service'; @Component({ selector: 'app-shipment-tracker', standalone: true, imports: [CommonModule], template: `
Live Terminal Logistics

Export Container & Import LC Terminal Tracker

Real-time monitoring of outbound export shipments and inbound raw material cotton & dye consignments.

Display Currency: {{ dataService.currentCurrency().code }} ({{ dataService.currentCurrency().symbol }})
@for (shp of dataService.filteredShipments(); track shp.id) { }
Tracking & B/L ID Type & Division Buyer / Supplier Route (Origin → Destination) Contract Value Logistics Progress ETA
{{ shp.id }} {{ shp.containerSize }}
B/L: {{ shp.bolNumber }}
LC: {{ shp.lcNumber }}
{{ shp.type }}
{{ shp.division }}
{{ shp.itemsDescription }}
{{ shp.clientOrSupplier }}
Qty: {{ shp.quantityUnits }}
🛫 {{ shp.originPort }}
🛬 {{ shp.destinationPort }}
Vessel: {{ shp.vesselName }}
{{ dataService.formatValue(shp.valueUSD) }}
\${{ shp.valueUSD.toLocaleString() }} USD
{{ shp.status }} {{ shp.progressPercentage }}%
{{ shp.eta }}
@if (dataService.filteredShipments().length === 0) {

No matching shipments found.

Try clearing your search query or selecting "All Shipments".

}
` }) export class ShipmentTrackerComponent { dataService = inject(ExportImportDataService); onDivisionChange(event: Event) { const val = (event.target as HTMLSelectElement).value; this.dataService.selectedDivisionFilter.set(val); } }
